title: IVG Pro Salts Purple Lemonade 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Purple Lemonade 10ml E-Liquid provides a lively and complex twist on a classic summer drink. The inhale features the dark, jammy sweetness of mixed Forest Berries, establishing a rich and satisfying fruit base. This is expertly countered by the sharp, citrus bite of sparkling Lemonade on the exhale, creating a brilliantly balanced, sweet-and-sour profile that is refreshing and deeply flavoursome. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the rich citrus tang of Purple Lemonade, vapers can explore other standout options such as the frosty chill of Red Freeze or the pure botanical taste of Fresh Mint, ensuring a premium choice for every preference.
